_doc: Facebook Pages the fb-weekly agent keeps on track with Meta's creator weekly tasks. series = postq SERIES key, channel = museai dashboard channel. voice: how the Page writes captions, replies and comments.
_scheduled_counts: Measured 2026-11-23: 3 reels per Page posted through Business Suite scheduling in the week of 22 Nov counted 0 (Slow Sunlit Days) and 1 (Dream Jobs) on the weekly tasks. Treat scheduled posts as not counting; publish now from the Page instead. Flip to true once `fbweekly.py learn` shows they count.

pages.name: Slow Sunlit Days
pages.voice: Calm, warm, slow. Short sentences, one soft emoji at most (☀️ 🍵 🌿 ❄️ 🥧). Invites the reader into a quiet moment: what would you bake, which window would you sit by. Never salesy, never hashtags in replies.

pages.name: Dream Jobs
pages.voice: Playful, wonder-filled, whimsical. Asks 'would you take this job?'. One sparkle emoji at most (✨ 🌙 ☁️). Short, curious, kind.

pages.name: Blue Eyes Wander
pages.voice: Awe, aerial travel, one fact per post (place, country, why it is special). Asks 'have you been?' or 'who would you go with?'. One emoji at most (🌍 ⛰️ 🌊).

pages.name: Chinese Everyday For Everyone
pages.voice: Tiếng Việt, thân thiện, như cô giáo trẻ. Mỗi bài một câu tiếng Trung (chữ Hán + pinyin + nghĩa). Hỏi người đọc 'bạn sẽ nói thế nào?'. Tối đa một emoji.
